title: The strategy a session chose is posted as a coord event and shown once to the other session, so both know who waits for whom
goal: coord.py post --kind coordinate takes the fields item, other, strategy (wait, ask, after, join, proceed), touch, session and operator, and kbask.py coordinate ITEM OTHER STRATEGY posts it for the session that chose; when announce.to_other_sessions is true the coord hook shows it once, at the other session's next SessionStart, Bash, Skill, Edit or Write event, as a plain line (session s-xxxxxx of operator ID will wait for your landing of ITEM before editing FILES), and kbmon's log panel and --events show it as coord.coordinate

run:
import subprocess, tempfile, os, sys, json, uuid, glob
S = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'c.sqlite')
env = dict(os.environ, KB_COORD_STORE=S)
def c(*a): return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/coord.py', '--store', S, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
other = str(uuid.uuid4())
c('claim', 'session/' + other, '--ttl', '600', '--holder', other)
c('post', '--kind', 'intent', '--field', 'session=' + other, '--field', 'item=ST-ab12cd34', '--field', 'touch=_tools/bl_land.py')
post = c('post', '--kind', 'coordinate', '--field', 'item=ST-ef56gh78', '--field', 'other=ST-ab12cd34',
         '--field', 'strategy=wait', '--field', 'touch=_tools/bl_land.py')
payload = {'hook_event_name': 'PreToolUse', 'session_id': other, 'tool_name': 'Bash', 'cwd': os.getcwd(),
           'tool_input': {'command': 'git status'}}
st = os.path.join('_cache', 'coord_hook', other + '.json')
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(st), exist_ok=True)
json.dump({'items': ['ST-ab12cd34'], 'asks_seq': 0}, open(st, 'w', encoding='utf-8'))
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '.claude/hooks/coord_hook.py'], input=json.dumps(payload), capture_output=True,
                   text=True, env=env)
for f in glob.glob(os.path.join('_cache', 'coord_hook', other + '*')):
    os.remove(f)
try:
    msg = json.loads(r.stdout).get('systemMessage', '')
except ValueError:
    msg = ''
ok = post.returncode == 0 and all(w in msg for w in ('will wait', 'ST-ab12cd34', 'ST-ef56gh78'))
print('post exit', post.returncode, '| other session sees:', msg[:200] or '(none)')
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
